cityWide.basis: €23.40 per m² × 50 m², the app's assumed size for 1 bedroom.
cityWide.limitations: Average asking rent per m² on idealista for the city of Madrid in September 2026; districts range from about €17 to €28.5. Existing leases are much lower (€12.8 per m² in 2022, Ministry of Housing reference index).

rent.adjustment: Converted from a rent per m² at 50 m².

rent.adjustment: Converted from a rent per m² at 70 m².

groceriesPerAdultEquivalent.basis: Average spending in Finland on food and drink at home, €362 a month per adult equivalent in 2024, priced here: prices are 0.88 times Finland's.
groceriesPerAdultEquivalent.limitations: Price levels from the 2021 international comparison, moved to 2024 with overall inflation; national prices, so the city itself may differ.

1.basis: Electricity: 2,000 kWh a year (app assumption for 1 bedroom) at €0.2669 per kWh, the national household price with taxes.
1.limitations: Electricity use is an app assumption and varies with appliances, cooking and cooling.

2.limitations: Electricity use is an app assumption and varies with appliances, cooking and cooling.

waterPerPerson.basis: Average water and sanitation cost in the Community of Madrid in 2024 (€1.74 per m³) at the measured average use of 128 litres a person a day (INE).

transitPassAdult.basis: 30-day public transport pass, zone A, at the 2026 discounted price (Consorcio Regional de Transportes, BOCM 31 Dec 2025).

healthcarePerPerson.basis: Household out-of-pocket health spending per inhabitant in Spain (€647.45 a year).
healthcarePerPerson.limitations: A national average across all ages; spending is lower for most working-age adults and higher for older people.

childcarePerChild.basis: Public nursery schools (0–3) in the Community of Madrid: tuition is free; meals cost €96 a month.
childcarePerChild.limitations: Public places are limited; private nurseries charge tuition, which is not included.
